info.title: Enterprise Forms Business API
info.description: Browser-facing business API generated from compiled feature endpoints (ADR-PB-006). The Authorization Authority contract is private and published separately.

get.summary: Process liveness. Never consults external dependencies.
Readiness. Fails closed when the Authorization Authority is unconfigured or unreachable.
Verified principal of the current assertion (projection maintenance only; confers no permission).

People directory (PG-050, read-only): identities the Authority has bound that have signed in (business projection, labelled), their teams, and Security Administrator badges from the Authority roster. Organization owners and Security Administrators only; 403 otherwise. Never an email key; never record content.
Current browser session (no secrets): authenticated flag, organization, CSRF token for mutations.
Synthetic personas seeded through the authority operator plane. 404 outside Development/Testing.

post.summary: Development/Testing only: starts a BFF session for a seeded persona. Refused elsewhere by construction.
Revokes the session at the Authority, then deletes the cookie. 503 SESSION_STATE_UNAVAILABLE if revocation cannot be confirmed (cookie kept for a retry).

get.summary: Authenticated bootstrap: user, capabilities, safe branding, UI preferences and current authorization revision (no record counts).

post.summary: Registers a form with the authority (designer role) and publishes a minimal v1 layout. Requires Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Forms the caller may design or use (authority-filtered; no other forms are disclosed).

patch.summary: Renames a form (display name only; no new version). Requires the Authority design permission on the form (404 otherwise); 409 FORM_DEFINITION_MODIFIED_CONCURRENTLY when expectedFormDefinitionRevision is stale; 422 for an empty, over-long or control-character name; audited (FORM_RENAMED).

post.summary: Registers a new form with the authority and opens an empty draft (no published version yet). Requires Idempotency-Key.
Adds a stable field identity (storage type immutable after creation).
Creates the stable repeating group behind a section that allows multiple entries (key permanent).

patch.summary: Edits a field's catalog label and description (expected revision required); key and storage type are permanent and a differing value is refused.

get.summary: Classification, storage protection, search impact and migration state of a field.

post.summary: Audited migration: raise classification and/or switch a field to application encryption (starts the authority-governed background re-encryption of existing plaintext values). Downgrades are refused.
Re-queues the failed records of a field's encryption migration (design permission; audited).

Phase C7 M4 (G19): queues a verify-only reconciliation of the field's current protection decision against the Authorization Authority's complete record population (Worker verifier; never converts anything; same permission as retrying the migration; audited). 409 while the migration or another reconciliation is still running.
Amendment A1: declassifies an encrypted field to Public/Internal through the authority's ReclassifyField command (organization owner or system administrator; governance approval reference).

Amendment A1: releases a Public/Internal field from application encryption (organization owner or system administrator; distinct principal for declassified fields) and starts the audited background decryption migration.
Amendment A1 rollback: re-requires encryption and re-encrypts already converted active values (organization owner or system administrator).

get.summary: Who may design and who may create records, read from the independent Authorization Authority (design permission or organization administration required).

post.summary: Grants/revokes create-record permission as an authority command; no form version is created and no existing record access changes.

put.summary: Adds, relabels, reorders or deactivates options; keys and ids are stable, nothing is deleted.
Saves the draft layout (schema v2, validated) with draft-revision CAS.

post.summary: Atomically publishes the draft as an immutable version and advances the current pointer (expected draft revision + current version number).
Copies a published version into the draft; publishing creates a NEW version (history is never rewritten).
Pulls the shared option list into the field: adds new items, follows labels, deactivates items the list deactivated. Keys and ids never change; nothing is deleted.
Defines a reusable related-form list (e.g. AccusedAddressList): parent → child form, bounds, cycle-checked.

get.summary: Shared dropdown option lists of the organization (designers only).

post.summary: Creates a reusable option list; binding it to a field copies its items into the field.

put.summary: Renames a list and adds, relabels, reorders or deactivates its items (expected revision required; keys permanent, nothing deleted). Fields and published versions are unaffected until a field syncs.

post.summary: Registers the record with the authority, validates typed values against the published layout, stages the signed candidate and commits the first accepted content revision.

get.summary: My Records: every authority-discoverable record of the caller (all discover pages at one authorization revision), filtered (form, status, child records), sorted (modifiedOn, createdOn, formName, recordStatus; record id tie-break) and paged with opaque cursors bound to caller, filters, search, sort and authorization revision. q (optional) narrows the list to an exact record id or short reference REC-XXXXXXXX decided from the same complete authorized set (never a field-value search; anything else is 422 LOOKUP_INVALID); an exact search also finds archived and related records, and the Form and Status filters still apply. Rows carry unverified local metadata only; open a record for the verified projection.
Verified read: authority head → exact staged rows → complete manifest verification → authorized subset only.

patch.summary: Optimistic (expected_content_revision or If-Match) full-snapshot typed update staged as a new immutable candidate and committed by the authority.

get.summary: Verified projection for the UI: layout version, field metadata, authorized values and documents, permitted actions, ETag.

Phase C6 M2: accepted versions of a record in chronological order, from the Authorization Authority (AC-1): version number, accepted time, actor, current marker. Action labels carry their source (Authority or the unverified activity log). Only a person who may read the whole record now; anyone else gets 404.

Phase C6 M2: one earlier version, read-only, after the Authority verified its exact rows against the manifest it accepted for that version (any mismatch fails closed: 423, the record is quarantined as for the current version). Current form layout and labels; the version's values, documents and status.

Phase C6 M3: what restoring an earlier version would change (owner only; nothing is written). The version is verified through the Authority's history; current and restored values side by side (no-store), new entries, unchanged documents, current-form validation, values that would lose application encryption (OD-13), and whether the restore is possible now (Draft only).

post.summary: Phase C6 M3: restores the field values and repeating-section entries of an earlier version as a NEW revision (owner, Draft, reason required, optimistic by If-Match/expected revision, idempotent). The source is verified through the Authority's history; values are validated against the current form (all-or-nothing) and stored under the current protection policy; documents, related records, status, owners and shares are not restored; anything that exists only in the version gets a new identity.

Lifecycle transition 'Submit' (owner only): optimistic by If-Match/expected revision and expected status, committed as a new accepted revision through the authority; the verified signed header carries the status.

Lifecycle transition 'Reopen' (owner only): optimistic by If-Match/expected revision and expected status, committed as a new accepted revision through the authority; the verified signed header carries the status.

Lifecycle transition 'Archive' (owner only): optimistic by If-Match/expected revision and expected status, committed as a new accepted revision through the authority; the verified signed header carries the status.

Lifecycle transition 'Unarchive' (owner only): optimistic by If-Match/expected revision and expected status, committed as a new accepted revision through the authority; the verified signed header carries the status.

get.summary: Authorized, verified child records of a related-form list (no hidden counts).

post.summary: Creates a child record linked to the parent through the authority (parent edge, signed header binding). Requires Idempotency-Key.
Authority UnlinkChildRecord command: removes the parent edge, keeps the data, remover becomes owner.
Opens an authorized, idempotent chunked upload session bound to a record's document collection field.

put.summary: Streams one exact-size chunk (4 MiB; last chunk remainder) into quarantine; acknowledged ranges are server truth.

post.summary: Idempotent finalize: assembles quarantined chunks and queues durable scan/encrypt processing. 202 = queued, not Ready.
Binds the processed (clean, encrypted) version into the record's signed manifest through the caller's authority context; the document becomes Ready.

get.summary: The caller's own upload sessions and their authoritative processing stage.
Documents whose version leaf is in the accepted manifest and authorized for the caller.
Authorized download: re-verifies the record projection, decrypts server-side, streams with no-store and attachment disposition.

post.summary: Removes the document from the accepted content by committing a new revision without its leaf; bytes and history are retained.
Explicit field allow-list share committed by the authority; no wildcard or future items.

get.summary: Shares of a record for its access managers (local projection; the authority decides every recipient's access).
Display-name directory of the organization's teams (projection; confers nothing).

Team detail and roster (PG-049) from the projection, each membership carrying the Authority command that made it effective. Owners and Security Administrators only; another organization's team is the same generic 404 as an unknown id.

patch.summary: Display-only rename of the team projection (D8-8; the Authority names no team). Organization owners and Security Administrators (the Authority's team-command rule); audited (TEAM_RENAMED); 409 TEAM_MODIFIED_CONCURRENTLY when expectedModifiedOn is stale.

post.summary: Submits AddTeamMember to the Authority (organization owner or Security Administrator; never oneself as a Security Administrator, G25). The durable operation is recorded first; the roster changes only when the Worker projects the Authority-confirmed state (never written by this request). 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED for the same key with another request; a completed operation is never re-sent.
Submits RemoveTeamMember to the Authority; same rules as AddTeamMember. The member stays on the roster until the Worker projects the Authority-confirmed removal.

get.summary: One add/remove operation of the team (organization owners and Security Administrators). Another organization's or team's operation is the same 404 as an unknown id.
The caller's own operation by the Idempotency-Key it sent (after a lost response). Only the initiating administrator finds it; the key is never returned.

post.summary: Asks the Worker to look the operation up again at once (audited TEAM_MEMBERSHIP_OPERATION_RECHECKED). Never submits or replays a command; a ReconciliationError re-opens and still projects only a validated Authority answer. 409 when the operation is complete.
Records that an administrator reviewed a failed or anomalous operation (audited TEAM_MEMBERSHIP_OPERATION_REVIEWED). Changes no roster and no Authority state.

get.summary: Team directory with member counts (PG-048). Organization owners and Security Administrators only; 403 otherwise, without counts.
Authorized widget descriptors from the static catalog; no inline data, no arbitrary endpoints.
Counts computed only over resources discoverable by the caller.

Status counts and created/submitted activity over the caller's complete Authority-discoverable top-level records (listing metadata, unverified). periodDays 7, 30 or 90; timeZone is an IANA id (UTC otherwise).
The caller's own upload sessions in the period, by outcome group.
A page of the caller's own upload sessions, newest first. q matches the file name (literal, case-insensitive); status is InProgress, Completed, Failed or Cancelled.
A page of the caller's own audit events, newest first, filtered by category, outcome and time range.
A page of the forms the caller may use or design (Authority decisions), by name. access is create or design; status is published or unpublished.
Record activity timeline (local audit projection; authority Read permission required).

put.summary: OrganizationOwner only; WCAG pairwise contrast validated server-side; revision CAS.

get.summary: Data-protection policy: minimum field classification and whether plaintext Internal fields are permitted (ADR-PB-004).

put.summary: OrganizationOwner only; reason required; audited; revision CAS.

get.summary: The organization's Security Administrators (Authority relation system_administrator) — for its organization owners (read-only) and Security Administrators (with candidates); 403 for everyone else.

post.summary: Appoints an existing verified member as Security Administrator: a GrantSystemRole security command that only a Security Administrator may submit, with step-up (unavailable in staging and production until PB-08). Reason required; audited by the Authority. 204 once Effective.

Removes a Security Administrator (RevokeSystemRole, step-up, reason, audited). The last Security Administrator cannot be removed (409 LAST_SECURITY_ADMINISTRATOR). 204 once Effective; self-removal allowed while another remains.

get.summary: Organization overview (PG-041): organization identity, member and Security Administrator counts, teams, data-protection floor and authentication status as independently computed parts (an unavailable part never fails the page). Organization owners and Security Administrators only; 403 for everyone else, without counts.
Display-name directory of users seen in this organization (projection; confers nothing).

Server-authoritative Advanced Search capabilities for one form and the caller: the fields that may be used as predicates, their value types and allowed operators, and fields the caller may know about that cannot be searched (Encrypted for privacy — not searchable). A field the caller may not know about is in neither list. Phase C7 M2: fields come from the Authority (AC-6 approvals and the caller's field_searcher permission, with the approval's frozen labels and options); fieldValueSearchAvailable stays false (TRUSTED_SEARCH_NOT_ENABLED) because execution (M3) is not enabled.

post.summary: Advanced field search over one selected form: up to five conditions combined with AND, each on a field from the capability list with an allowed operator and a typed invariant value, plus the My Records metadata filters. A result is returned only when every eligible record was independently enumerated and verified at one snapshot; otherwise a typed failure (SEARCH_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED, SEARCH_OPERATOR_NOT_SUPPORTED, SEARCH_VERIFICATION_LIMIT, SEARCH_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED, SEARCH_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE), never a partial page. Each condition is first authorized against the Authority's capabilities (422 SEARCH_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED / SEARCH_OPERATOR_NOT_SUPPORTED). Phase C7 M3: executed only where the fail-closed execution gate is on (isolated Development/Testing); otherwise 503 SEARCH_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE (TRUSTED_SEARCH_NOT_ENABLED). Overload: 503 SEARCH_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE (SEARCH_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, retryable).

Another page of a verified advanced-search result: the opaque cursor is bound to the caller, session, query digest and verified snapshot; a changed authorization or content snapshot returns 409 SEARCH_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED (restart from page one). Nothing is re-evaluated: the page comes from the verified result the cursor carries, after the Authority re-validates its snapshot.

get.summary: Search configuration of the form's latest Authority-registered published version: per field its classification, protection, eligibility, approval state and operators. Designers of the form and security administrators only (others: 404). Encrypted fields are reported as Encrypted (Encrypted for privacy — not searchable).

post.summary: Asks the Authority to approve plaintext value search of a field for the given operators (security administrators only; governance reference required). The Authority refuses encrypted, Confidential/Restricted and below-floor fields, unregistered versions and unsupported operators, and refuses every approval while step-up assurance (PB-08) is unavailable — in production and staging always.
Withdraws a field's search approval (security administrators only, reason required).

put.summary: Grants or revokes the form's field_searcher relation (query permission for its approved fields) for users or teams. Security administrators only. Form access, record ownership and design access never imply it.

get.summary: Phase C7 M3: for security administrators (administer_security) only — the organization's forms with an Authority-registered published version, their registered title and version, field and approval counts. Search approval administration without Designer or record access; 403 for everyone else.
A page of the organization's security incidents, most recently detected first. q is an incident reference (INC-…), a record reference (REC-…, discoverable records only) or a full identifier.
Incident counts by status, severity and detection date. Zero incidents is not evidence that data was verified.
Incident metadata, detection history, notes and audit trail (audited: SECURITY_INCIDENT_VIEWED). No record content.

patch.summary: Change status or investigator (audited). 409 INCIDENT_MODIFIED_CONCURRENTLY when expectedIncidentRevision is stale. Closing never restores record visibility.

post.summary: Append an investigation note (audited without its text).
